correctness.rationale: Exact local edge-conflict analysis yields a star conflict graph plus isolated choice, so the polynomial factors as stated. The strict Newton binomial-normalization failure at index 2 proves non-real roots for every d>=4; lower d are explicitly real-rooted. A complete six-isomorphism-class forest census yields unique order-six failure; all smaller/disconnected forests factor into real-rooted cases. Exact standard-library independent tests support the enumerative identities but do not replace the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact first non-real-rooted forest and its uniqueness locate a natural zero-geometry boundary. A uniform infinite-family threshold proves the phenomenon is structural and persistent, not a numerical anomaly. Real-rootedness is a meaningful stronger property than coefficient unimodality and contrasts with matching-polynomial real-rootedness for forests. Neither an arbitrary slice nor only a pointwise special-case check.
